company.name: LOVANSTRIX
company.heroHeading: Turn ideas into immersive digital experiences.
company.heroSubtitle: We shape business websites, custom applications, and practical AI tools into digital experiences built around your next big idea.
company.shortIntroduction: Founded as an emerging technology venture, Lovanstrix works directly with individuals, founders, educators, and growing businesses to turn practical ideas into clean, maintainable digital products and software systems.
company.mission: Build useful, accessible, and innovative digital solutions.
company.vision: To grow into a multidisciplinary technology company that develops useful digital products, builds innovative web and AI applications, and collaborates with talented engineers and builders.
company.stageDisclosure: Lovanstrix is an emerging early-stage technology venture. We focus on direct founder-led engineering, transparent project scoping, and verifiable prototypes—never fabricating client logos, team headcount, or commercial claims.
company.careerStatusBanner: Lovanstrix is growing its engineering and design collaborations. Explore published roles or register in our talent network for upcoming project opportunities.
company.founderBio: Lovanstrix is led directly by its founder with a focus on full-stack MERN web engineering, clean JavaScript architectures, and applied AI workflows. Specific founder biography and credentials can be updated anytime via the Admin Console.

services.title: Website Design and Development
services.summary: Custom, mobile-responsive websites engineered from scratch with modern typography, fast load times, and semantic SEO.
services.overview: We design and develop modern websites tailored to your brand identity and audience. Instead of bloated page-builders, we write clean, maintainable React, TypeScript, and semantic HTML/CSS so your website loads fast and scales cleanly as your organization grows.
problemsAddressed: Outdated, non-responsive websites that break on mobile and tablet screens
Slow-loading template sites with poor search visibility and cluttered navigation
Difficulty updating service pages or company announcements without breaking layouts
deliverables: Custom responsive multi-page or single-page website architecture
Semantic HTML5 structure, OpenGraph social cards, and Schema.org metadata
Accessible contact and enquiry forms with client + server validation
Cross-browser testing across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports
processSteps: Discover: Understand your objectives, users, and practical constraints.
Plan: Define system architecture, data models, and milestone deliverables.
Design: Create accessible wireframes, high-contrast UI components, and responsive layouts.
Develop: Write clean TypeScript, React, and backend API code.
Test: Validate forms, cross-device responsiveness, and edge cases.
Launch: Deploy to cloud hosting with documentation and handover.

faqs.question: Do you use pre-made generic templates?
faqs.answer: No. Every Lovanstrix website is architected with custom components tailored to your specific content, brand colors, and goals.

Transparent database persistence and optional server-side email webhook forwarding

projects.title: Interactive 3D Spatial Engineering Core
projects.objective: Showcase an interactive Three.js / WebGL spatial installation embedded inside a high-contrast startup website with hardware-accelerated raycasting and fallback controls.

Instant toggle between 3D Interactive Core and 2D SVG Blueprint

Foundation for future IoT and connected sensor research projects
